subdomains.name: Cloud Subdomain (Air)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Electricity Resistance with Thundercloud and replace the Air domain's 4th- and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Lightning Arc
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet, dealing 1d6 electricity damage plus 1 per two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Thundercloud
powers.summary: Create a movable fog cloud that deafens creatures within it and deals 2d6 electricity damage each round. Usable for a number of rounds per day equal to cleric level.

subdomains.name: Wind Subdomain (Air)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Lightning Arc with Wind Blast and replace the Air domain's 1st-, 6th-, and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Wind Blast
powers.summary: Unleash a 30-foot line and make bull rush checks using caster level as base attack bonus and Wisdom in place of Strength. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Electricity Resistance
powers.summary: Gain electricity resistance 10 at 6th level, increasing to 20 at 12th level and immunity at 20th level.

subdomains.name: Caves Subdomain (Earth)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Acid Resistance with Tunnel Runner and replace the Earth domain's 2nd-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Acid Dart
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet, dealing 1d6 acid damage plus 1 per two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Tunnel Runner
powers.summary: Gain spider climb on stone, darkvision, and underground bonuses to Stealth and initiative for 1 minute per cleric level per day.

subdomains.name: Metal Subdomain (Earth)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Acid Dart with Metal Fist and replace the Earth domain's 2nd-, 6th-, and 8th-level spells.

powers.name: Metal Fist
powers.summary: As a swift action, turn your fists to metal for 1 round; unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage, do not provoke, and ignore hardness 10 or lower. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Acid Resistance
powers.summary: Gain acid resistance 10 at 6th level, increasing to 20 at 12th level and immunity at 20th level.
